risk.rationale: The only verified evidence is F1 (LIKELY 0.6): a sign-in from previously unseen device PH-9900 for an account whose usual device is LT-6002 (T1078). The two password-spray claims were rejected as shared-egress background noise (186 and 208 distinct MFA accounts from those IPs), so there is no confirmed account-takeover chain to warrant contain. The new-device signal is not explained away, so it is not benign. There are no data-quality conflicts or exposure requiring human escalation. A single LIKELY new-device sign-in is a weak unexplained signal -> monitor.
